messages:
deploy-bot: 🚀 Starting region rollout: release/v2.4.1 -> prod. Regions: [us, eu, apac]. Commit: 3b7f9e2. Change window: 23:00-03:00 UTC. Canary on 1% traffic per region. Tags/notes: hotfixes for tokenization edge-case. Logs: /releases/1781203456

maya: tagging FYI — EU infra still running pinned libimage v1.8, make sure compat flag is on for eu canary.

owen: noted, i've added compat=false override for eu canary so it uses the fallback adapter. pin still possible if issues.

deploy-bot: US: canary -> healthy (10m). metrics: p50=90ms p95=220ms errors=0. EU: canary -> healthy (9m). metrics: p50=95ms p95=240ms errors=0. APAC: canary -> paused (5m). reason: spike in 503s and rate of KvCache misses increased x5. see snippet: ```[2026-03-18T00:12:34Z] svc=runtime region=apac status=503 route=/v1/generate commit=3b7f9e2```. :warning:

jules: do we have a correlation with the new kv-cache eviction heuristic? APAC traffic has longer seq lengths. If true we should pin apac back to release/v2.4.0 and run a targeted canary with increased kv-cache size.

maya: +1 to pin APAC to v2.4.0 while we investigate. That gives SLO safety for customer-facing routes.

sre-oncall: opening an incident ticket now: INC-2026-0318-01. Will collect traces and heatmaps. If pin required, please run the rollback tag command below.

owen: executing: `deploy rollback --env=prod --region=apac --to-tag=release/v2.4.0 --reason='canary-503-spike' --force-pin`

deploy-bot: APAC: rollout paused and pinned to release/v2.4.0 (rollback initiated by owen). Canary will retry tomorrow 02:00 UTC with kv-cache tuning. Incident INC-2026-0318-01 linked.

jules: added to release notes draft: "APAC canary exhibited increased 503s; pinned region to previous release while we tune kv-cache heuristic. A targeted canary will re-run after fix."

maya: 👍  please add regression test for long-seq path in nightly evals.

deploy-bot: US: finished (success). EU: finished (success). APAC: rolled back -> release/v2.4.0, status=stable. Closing rollout for APAC until canary re-run. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: monitoring, will update INC ticket with findings. If we need full rollback beyond APAC, will escalate.

owen: thanks team. I'll follow up with the kv-cache PR and a short runbook for pinning flows.

jules: ping me if you want me to prepare customer comms for affected APAC accounts.
